title: Serratia marcescens 与晚疫病菌的化学互作机制首次通过多层次功能代谢组学解析
originalTitle: Multi-Layer Functional Metabolomics Reveals Chemical Interactions Between the Plant-Associated Bacterium Serratia marcescens and Phytophthora
summary: 某团队开发了一种结合LC-MS/MS金属内源素测试与微分馏生物测试的多层次功能代谢组学方法，首次鉴定了Serratia marcescens中serratiochelins及其衍生物prodigiosin与铁的结合特性，并提出了serratiochelin G的合成起源假说。
